title: Steven Lovekin: Eisenhower doodled UFOs at Mount Weather, UFO headquarters

tellings.quote: to him about being inside Mount Weather with with uh Eisenhower and he he said Eisenhower would doodle UFO stuff and that sort of stuff and that Eisenhower was this is where UFOs were headquartered.

related.note: Both are Lovekin's testimony that Eisenhower doodled UFO craft. This telling puts it at Mount Weather as UFO headquarters; the story has it at the White House, with Eisenhower saying he no longer controlled the issue.

plain: In the 1950s, the story goes, President Eisenhower sat inside Mount Weather, a government site in Virginia, doodling UFOs, and this was where the UFO matter was run from. A guest named Grant Cameron passes it on as something a man named Stephen Lovekin told about being inside Mount Weather with Eisenhower, apparently in a conversation with Steven Greer, a well-known figure in UFO circles. If true, it would put the president himself close to a hidden centre for the subject.
